why: NEEDS_USER §0ס was closed on 12/08 after `vercel env ls` showed both keys it asked for had been set 17 days earlier. It was written up as blocked without running the command that checks. This run applies the same command to every remaining env-var ask in NEEDS_USER §3, and cross-checks each variable NAME against the code that reads it.

method.env: GET https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/<project>/env?teamId=team_NLONMgS3DlFsznzcrz0j3OMs (Bearer token from disk). Values are `sensitive` and not returned; key names, targets and createdAt are.
method.readers: Select-String over the app source on disk (apps/** is gitignored, so ripgrep/git grep are blind to it) for `process.env.<NAME>` / `import.meta.env.<NAME>`.
method.not_measured: The VALUE of any variable. Vercel does not return sensitive values, so 'set' here means the key exists on Production, not that it is correct.

findings.measured: No file in apps/17-chizukim-transcribe reads RUNPOD_API_KEY. The reader is CUSTOM_CRED_API_RUNPOD_AI_TOKEN (server/routes.ts:90 and :131, and the built api/handler.js), with an optional CUSTOM_CRED_API_RUNPOD_AI_URL override. Neither is set on chizukim2-more30. Its absence is handled, not fatal: routes.ts branches on the token and falls back to OpenAI (TRANSCRIBE_MODEL, default gpt-transcribe) -- and OPENAI_API_KEY IS set on that project, Production, since 2026-07-26.
findings.consequence: Transcription has a configured engine today. What the missing token buys is price: the cost constants in the same file are 0.0004 $/min on RunPod against 0.006 $/min on OpenAI, i.e. 15x. This is an optimisation, not the outage it was filed as.

findings.measured: Two things. (a) chatzor-more30 has ZERO environment variables of any kind -- it is a Vite SPA deployed prebuilt, so its Supabase values are baked in at build time from apps/16-chatzor-connect/.env.local, which is why it works with an empty Vercel env. (b) Nothing in apps/16 would consume a maps key: the only Google reference in the whole tree is src/hooks/useNearby.ts:48, a plain google.com/maps/dir deep link that needs no key. Separately, GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY already exists on nadlan-more30 (production, 2026-07-29).
findings.consequence: The row asked the user to obtain something the account already has, for a code path that does not exist. If walking distance is wanted in 16 it is a build task first, and the key is then a copy, not an acquisition.
